name: Deliberately Cut Wires
description: The lamp mechanism's wiring was cut cleanly, not damaged by storm weather.

name: Neighboring Harbor Log
description: A harbor logbook showing Barnaby's boat departed, not stayed docked, during the exact hours in question.

name: Unmarked Shipping Manifest
description: A manifest for an unregistered night crossing, timed for the same storm, found stuffed behind a shelf.

name: Wet Boot Prints
description: Salt-water boot prints leading up the spiral staircase, drying at exactly the time the light failed.

name: Torn Logbook Page
description: A single torn page from Aldous's own logbook, snagged on the lantern room's railing -- he saw something and tried to record it.
